displayName: voyager-crawler: LLM forced off by an invalid [llm] config

documentation.content: `VC_LLM_ENABLED=true` but the `[llm]` settings are invalid (e.g. `VC_PROJECT_CAP_USD` missing or 0, or the monthly cap above 50 % of it), so every role started with the LLM **off** instead of refusing to start. Fix `/var/lib/voyager-crawler/deploy/host.local.env` (infrastructure/README.md, owner step 3); each role logs the reason at startup.
